scoring_justification: Checker fits the data to the predicted scaling laws, extracts critical exponents, and compares them to paper gold values; full recompute from raw artifact.

output_contract.notes: All CSV files are produced by the solving agent's simulation and disorder averaging. The hidden checker will perform separate regression analyses on each file to verify the predicted scaling forms (logarithmic for spin, power-law for energy) without relying on any self-reported metrics.

hidden_assets.purpose: exact magnetization exponents x_m and x_m^s, approximate energy exponents eta_e and eta_e^s
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper (exact x_m from golden mean, x_m^s=1/2, eta_e≈2.2, eta_e^s≈2.5)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: They are the paper's own critical exponents; the checker verifies that the agent's simulation data reproduces these known universal values.
